title: RTX 3070 Performance Review & Benchmarks - With a 7700K!
description:
This RTX 3070 review is going to be different.  It'll have the usual RTX 3070 Founders Edition price, availability, gaming benchmarks, performance, power consumption and temperature testing but we also wanted to address the upgrade question.  Will an older system be able to avoid CPU bottlenecking on the RTX 3070 when gaming at 1080P, 1440P and 4K?  For that we look at the RTX 3080 and RTX 3070 vs GTX 1070 Ti, GTX 1080 and GTX 1080 Ti on a gaming PC equipped with an i7-7700K and one with a i9-10900K.
